text: What'd you get mom for Christmas? I don't have any money, so I just got her a cheap candle. Okay, well I don't have that much money either, but I got her the new digital picture frame. This is a digital picture frame that allows you to upload any photo from your phone. It's so easy to use, you just plug it in, scan the QR code, and then upload any photo or video you want. Not only can you display the photos both vertically and horizontally with the weather and time, but they're already running their end of year sale. Now the coolest part is friends and family from literally anywhere can also upload photos to the frame. Now the only issue is with the holidays coming up, this sells out really quick. So if you want to take advantage of that affordable price while it's still in stock, then I'll try to link it somewhere down below. Just make sure if you see it available, you grab it before it's gone.
